scenes.title: Opening Theme Song
scenes.summary: Opening title sequence for Episode 10 of Behind the Scenes.

scenes.title: My Birthday Is in the Company File
scenes.summary: Surprised by a birthday bouquet at her desk when nobody in the city knows her birthday, Bu Xiaogu deduces with Qin Xiao and Xiaoye that someone with access to the personnel files remembered.

scenes.title: A Birthday Party Call and Foosball Opening
scenes.summary: Caught at a noisy surprise birthday party when Chun Yuqiao phones about work, Bu Xiaogu offers to leave immediately, while Yuqiao travels to Hong Kong with the chairwoman's brother to play foosball with an ad tycoon.
scenes.location: party venue and Hong Kong club

scenes.title: Being Your Best Self in Any Situation
scenes.summary: Thanking her wealthy admirer for the party, Bu Xiaogu asks whether Xin Huimei can help Xingtian's revamp and shares the life attitude she respects most: striving to become one's best self whether rich or poor.

scenes.title: Wagers Around the Foosball Table
scenes.summary: Spectators marvel at Chun Yuqiao's razor-sharp foosball precision and place playful side bets on the third game while the proud ad tycoon refuses to lose face.

scenes.title: Three Technical Fouls and Campus Foosball
scenes.summary: Chun Yuqiao deliberately commits three spin fouls so the match is voided without humiliating the ad tycoon, prompting Xingtian's longtime sponsor to outbid his rival for Twelve Singers Season Three.
scenes.location: Hong Kong foosball lounge and street

scenes.title: Distracted at Work for the First Time
scenes.summary: After sponsors rally behind the revamp overnight, Kaiwen catches a sleep-deprived Chun Yuqiao daydreaming at his desk over Bu Xiaogu's birthday party and urges him to make a move before it is too late.

scenes.title: Office Romances Bring Complications
scenes.summary: Kaiwen advises transferring Bu Xiaogu to Unit Two so daily work friction will not spoil romance; Chun Yuqiao worries that moving her now would crush her spirit as Xiaogu rushes in to announce the DTS revamp meeting.

scenes.title: Hosting the New Season of Twelve Singers
scenes.summary: Invited to DTS's cautious revamp review as a heavyweight advisor, veteran host Wen Simo feigns stern objections before praising Chun Yuqiao's bold localization plan and volunteering to host Twelve Singers himself.

scenes.title: Localization Is Television's True Path
scenes.summary: Privately after the meeting, Wen Simo warns Chun Yuqiao never to hurt Xin Huimei and pledges expert policy backing for network approval, while Xingzi reports that talent agencies are still boycotting Unit One.

scenes.title: Joining Twelve Singers Myself
scenes.summary: At a charity thank-you dinner earned by a three-million-yuan donation, Xin Huimei learns agencies are boycotting Chun Yuqiao's revamp, agrees to join Twelve Singers, and brushes off Weibo rumors of a secret marriage.

scenes.title: One More Round for the Golden Class
scenes.summary: Reuniting over hotpot nine years after their debut singing contest, Xin Huimei challenges her fellow Golden Class stars to compete together again on Twelve Singers as Bianbian's newsroom pushes the scoop nationwide.

scenes.title: A Clean Sweep This Season
scenes.summary: Following news of Xin Huimei's Golden Class reunion, the talent managers who previously boycotted Unit One flood Xingzi's phone begging to renew their contracts, giving Xingtian a resounding victory.

scenes.title: You Really Didn't Need to Go That Far
scenes.summary: Moved to learn her young admirer donated ninety-nine percent of his savings to build rural schools and win Xin Huimei's help, Bu Xiaogu accepts a ride home just as breaking news shows Huimei photographed with a child.
scenes.location: outside Xingtian building and sports car
